resumeText:
Kavita Rao | Mumbai | kavita.rao@example.com

SUMMARY
Security leader with 16 years in banking and payments security.

EXPERIENCE
Associate Director - Information Security, Western Coast Payments, Mumbai (2020 - present)
- Run the information security programme and the three-year security roadmap for the CISO.
- Maintain the risk register and agree treatment plans with system owners.
- Led readiness for RBI IT governance directions and CERT-In directions reporting.
- Keep ISO 27001 certification and map controls to NIST CSF.
- Approve enterprise security architecture standards for cloud and identity.
- Led incident response for a card data exposure and filed regulator reports.
- Manage IT audit findings from internal audit and RBI inspection teams.
- Managed a team of 22 through four security managers.
- Use stakeholder communication with the CTO, payments heads and the CISO.

Security Manager, Harbour Bank, Mumbai (2014 - 2020)
- Ran the SOC and vulnerability management.

Security Engineer, Deccan Infosystems, Pune (2010 - 2014)

CERTIFICATIONS
CISSP, CISM

EDUCATION
BE Computer Engineering, University of Mumbai, 2010
